question: What kind of message does Malone-san send to celebrate Otto's birthday?
answer: Malone: "Ooh, number two, it's your birthday! Don't be such a stranger, you should have let me know. ...After all, we're good friends, aren't we? But I really do want to celebrate. I'm able to be passing the time like this thanks to number two, you know. I'm grateful. ...If I could, it would be nice to be able to say it in person, you know."
